# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.8 Worker 3: seven families of flavour levies, 42 tiers (oe_levy_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v118_levies.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope, players only, once a year: one flavour event for a family the country can raise.
oe_levy_yearly_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_levy_ev1_done }
			oe_levy_is_stratiotai_country = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_levy_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_levy.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_levy_ev2_done }
			oe_levy_is_keshig_country = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_levy_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_levy.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_levy_ev3_done }
			oe_levy_is_streltsy_country = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_levy_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_levy.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_levy_ev4_done }
			oe_levy_is_cossacks_country = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_levy_ev4_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_levy.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_levy_ev5_done }
			oe_levy_is_timariot_country = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_levy_ev5_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_levy.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_levy_ev6_done }
			oe_levy_is_qizilbash_country = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_levy_ev6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_levy.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_levy_ev7_done }
			oe_levy_is_pospolite_country = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_levy_ev7_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_levy.7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_levy_ev8_done }
			oe_levy_is_mansabdari_country = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_levy_ev8_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_levy.8
	}
}
